caseName: Crooker v. United States Parole Commission
caseNameFull: Crooker v. United States Parole Commission

opinions.text: C. A. 1st Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of the Solicitor General's present interpretation of Fed. Rule Crim. Proc. 32 asserted in his brief ified October 3, 1984, on behalf of the Parole Commission.
